AGM Chilled Distribution
Extensive experience of delivering a range of frozen, chilled, ambient & heated products to our customers Nationwide.
Established in 2004, AGM Chilled Distribution Ltd services mainly the food industry. Using a modern fleet of fixed body vehicles ranging from 7.5 tonne to 26 tonne, we can carry loads ranging through frozen, chilled or ambient, with some vehicles having the option to carry a combination of temperature controlled and ambient products.
Working to the very highest standards we offer our customers vehicle tracking, monitoring progress of deliveries and providing feedback for customers. Also, operating to industry standards, we record and retain records of each delivery so if called upon these can be provided for customer and third party audits.
Our staff are friendly and helpful and will aim to provide assistance with either regular contracted work or respond to emergency dispatches when required.
